attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on AlmaLinux 9. Demonstrated failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to stream from node2, then rebuilt the former primary (node1) as a new standby of node2 via pg_basebackup after pg_rewind was blocked by missing wal_log_hints. Final steady state: node2 primary, node1 and node3 both streaming standbys, all committed rows (including a write made only after failover) consistent across all three nodes. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: restarted node3, node1, then node2 (primary last) one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, confirmed a changed OS boot_id on each, and verified PostgreSQL/replication fully recovered after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
